gaps.prev_text: You don't steal the fish from somebody else's plate.
gaps.next_text: The second he walked in I knew the kid was different.

gaps.prev_text: So we collect it, invest it. And he misuses Dust.
gaps.next_text: Complaints get handled here, not in back alleys. Applies, shall we say, Unnecessary force.

And I need both of those to take the galaxy.

cues.text: A woman sits backlit by a blue window.
He slams a table, scattering glowing chips.
He throws his arms back as golden energy erupts from him, his eyes glowing brightly.
In combat armor, he leaps through an explosion, firing a weapon.
The woman smirks. Everything fades to black.

beats.note: Four amphibious aliens stand around a dark table.
A flat-faced alien crosses his arms.
A green alien with chin tentacles speaks.
A woman with finned hair sits in shadow, backlit by a large blue window showing an underwater city.
A scarred green alien in a vest approaches the table.
The scarred alien slams his hands on a casino table, scattering glowing yellow chips. Other armed aliens stand behind him.
Two of the original aliens watch.
The scarred alien stands before the woman.
The scarred alien throws his arms back, engulfed in glowing golden energy, his eyes shining.
The scarred alien, now in combat armor, leaps through a fiery explosion, firing a heavy weapon.
